_comment: Single source of truth for the codex-acp full-access approval anchor (D-008 amendment, then the 2026-11-20 change to untrusted so Codex asks before every file patch) and the tool-deny patch (`deny`, #7764). Consumed by codex-acp-patch.ts (the runner image, via scripts/patch-codex-acp-approvals.ts) AND by services/runner/images/sandbox/daytona/build_snapshot.py (the Daytona snapshot image). Both surfaces MUST patch identically. Keep the anchors here and nowhere else.

deny._comment: When a user denies a tool approval, stock codex-acp forces action: 'cancel' for tool approvals, causing Codex to treat it as a transient cancellation and retry the tool call. These replacements offer 'Deny' (Decline) before Cancel and map Decline to action: 'decline' instead of action: 'cancel', so Codex acknowledges user refusal and does not retry (#7764).

replacements.find:
case McpApprovalOptionId.Decline:
      return !isToolApproval ? { action: "decline", content: null, _meta: null } : cancelledResponse();
replacements.replace:
case McpApprovalOptionId.Decline:
      return { action: "decline", content: null, _meta: null };
